VAULTS.Connect.Title: Connect to {vault}
VAULTS.Connect.Intro: This vault is role-gated, so Foundry needs a token to read it.
VAULTS.Connect.Open: Open the vault and sign in
VAULTS.Connect.SignIn: Approve access for Foundry VTT, then copy the token.
VAULTS.Warn.NoGraft: Wizzlethorpe Vaults needs the Graft module to build vault content. Install and enable Graft, then reload.
VAULTS.Fresh.Title: {module}: new content
VAULTS.Fresh.Body: The vault behind {module} has been updated since it was last built. Rebuild now?
VAULTS.Setup.Title: {module}: not built yet
VAULTS.Setup.Body: {module} is installed but its packs are empty. Build it now to pull the vault's content in? A role-gated vault will ask you to connect first.
